court_name: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
petitioner: Giri Textiles, through Proprietor Chandrayya R. Pasnuri
respondent: Anthony Nadar And Jainam Silk Mills

directives.text: The Labour Court shall endeavour to dispose of the said application as expeditiously as possible and preferably within a period of six months from the date of receipt of this order
directives.deadline_text: within a period of six months from the date of receipt of this order

raw_summary: The High Court dismissed a writ petition challenging orders from the Labour Court and Industrial Court. The petitioner's objection regarding the non-maintainability of an application due to the alleged non-compliance with Section 42(4) of the Maharashtra Industrial Relations Act was not accepted. The court held that the employer failed to prove communication of termination and that procedural objections cannot be used to deny substantive justice, especially when the employer's conduct contributed to the confusion.
